## 👋 About Me

Hi, I'm **Praveen Kumar T**, a BE/B.Tech graduate and fresher building my career in **embedded systems and firmware development**. I enjoy exploring how software interacts with hardware and developing practical projects with microcontrollers.

- 🔧 **Interests:** Embedded C, firmware development, IoT, RTOS, automotive embedded systems, robotics, and Embedded Linux.
- 🧠 **Technical areas:** C/C++, Python, microcontrollers, and UART / SPI / I²C communication protocols.
- 🏗️ **Projects:** Environment Monitoring System and Home Automation.
- 🌱 **Currently growing:** Hands-on firmware skills, debugging, real-time systems, and hardware–software integration.
- 🎯 **Career goal:** Find an entry-level opportunity where I can learn from experienced engineers and contribute to reliable embedded products.

> I’m at the beginning of my professional journey, so this profile will grow alongside my projects, experiments, and learning.

### 📌 Make each project recruiter-ready

For each project repository, try to include:

- **Problem statement** — what you wanted to solve.
- **Block diagram** — sensors, controller, outputs, and communication links.
- **Hardware and software requirements** — exact parts and tool versions.
- **How it works** — explain the firmware and important functions.
- **How to build and run** — clear steps another developer can reproduce.
- **Evidence** — photos, wiring diagrams, serial output, test cases, and a short GIF/video if available.
- **What I learned / future improvements** — be specific and honest.

## 🧭 My Embedded Systems Roadmap

```text
C fundamentals & memory concepts
          ↓
Microcontrollers · GPIO · timers · interrupts
          ↓
UART · SPI · I²C · ADC · PWM
          ↓
Drivers · debugging · datasheets · logic analyzer
          ↓
RTOS · tasks · queues · synchronization
          ↓
Embedded Linux · build tools · device interfaces
          ↓
Testing · documentation · version control
          ↓
Reliable firmware projects & continuous learning
```

**Areas I’m exploring:**

- [ ] Strengthen C: pointers, memory, bitwise operations, and data structures
- [ ] Build and document microcontroller peripheral projects
- [ ] Practice UART, SPI, and I²C communication with real hardware
- [ ] Learn debugging with serial logs and available debug tools
- [ ] Develop a small FreeRTOS project using tasks and synchronization
- [ ] Explore Embedded Linux fundamentals and build workflows
- [ ] Add test evidence and clear documentation to each project

*Update the checklist as you complete each item—only mark work that you have actually done.*
